title: atomic_dec_if_positive on FIPS provider unregister: correct underflow guard
description: src/provider/crypto2dev_registry.c crypto2dev_unregister_provider() — uses atomic_dec_if_positive() rather than atomic_dec() to decrement fips_provider_count. If the counter is already 0 (double-unregister, provider bug), atomic_dec() would take it to -1, making the (count > 0) FIPS mode check return false, silently disabling FIPS enforcement. atomic_dec_if_positive() returns -1 without decrementing, and WARN fires. A reviewer might call this defensive excess; it is not: a decrement to -1 would silently disable FIPS-only dispatch with no visible symptom, a CMVP compliance failure.
